blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: И как низок, бесчеловечен я, сидя здесь и не идя к нему на ___ (помощь)!
exercises.why: «Prepositions "В", "НА", "ПОД" and "ЗА" are followed by the Accusative case when they indicate the goal of motion.» — DLI, Lesson 61. From Антон Чехов, «Глупый француз».
exercises.context: «Prepositions "В", "НА", "ПОД" and "ЗА" are followed by the Accusative case when they indicate the goal of motion.» — DLI, Lesson 61.

exercises.q: «___ (бедняга)… — продолжал ужасаться француз.
exercises.why: «The main functions of the nominative case are: a. The nominative of the subject: Студент читает.» — DLI, Lesson 16. From Антон Чехов, «Глупый француз».
exercises.context: «The main functions of the nominative case are: a. The nominative of the subject: Студент читает.» — DLI, Lesson 16.

exercises.q: В ожидании, пока подадут консоме, Пуркуа ___ (заняться) наблюдением.
exercises.why: «The past tense is formed by dropping -ть from the infinitive and adding -л for the masculine, -ла for the feminine, -ло for the neuter, -ли for the plural … the past does not have special endings for each person, but shows the gender and the number.» — DLI, Lesson 36. From Антон Чехов, «Глупый француз».
exercises.context: «The past tense is formed by dropping -ть from the infinitive and adding -л for the masculine, -ла for the feminine, -ло for the neuter, -ли for the plural … the past does not have special endings for each person, but shows the gender and the number.» — DLI,…

exercises.q: И неужели он, чудак, воображает, что ___ (съесть) всю эту гору?
exercises.why: «The perfective future consists of one word only and resembles in form the present tense. It is formed from the perfective infinitive: напишу, сделаю, получу, выучу.» — DLI, Lesson 37. From Антон Чехов, «Глупый француз».
exercises.context: «The perfective future consists of one word only and resembles in form the present tense. It is formed from the perfective infinitive: напишу, сделаю, получу, выучу.» — DLI, Lesson 37.

exercises.q: Впрочем, такие феномены не ___ (составлять) редкости…
exercises.why: «The following verbs belong to the "Е" type of conjugation: думать, слушать, спрашивать … The verb лежать belongs to the "И" type of conjugation.» — DLI, Lesson 16. From Антон Чехов, «Глупый француз».
exercises.context: «The following verbs belong to the "Е" type of conjugation: думать, слушать, спрашивать … The verb лежать belongs to the "И" type of conjugation.» — DLI, Lesson 16.

exercises.q: Благообразный господин выпил рюмку водки, закусил семгой и ___ (принять / приняться) за блины.
exercises.why: «We already know that the verbs in "-ся" may be divided into several groups … Reflexive verbs. These verbs express an action which is directed back upon the agent or subject … Reciprocal verbs. The suffix "-ся" with these verbs indicates action of two or more actors upon one another … Verbs which never occur without the ending "-ся".» — DLI, Lesson 67. From Антон Чехов, «Глупый француз».
exercises.context: «We already know that the verbs in "-ся" may be divided into several groups … Reflexive verbs. These verbs express an action which is directed back upon the agent or subject … Reciprocal verbs.…

exercises.q: Они ещё рады, что за столом ___ (стоять / лежать / сидеть / висеть) сумасшедший, самоубийца, который может съесть на лишний рубль!
exercises.why: The imperfective aspect emphasizes the action itself. — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 37.  ·  «Phrases meaning direction are used to denote the place where something is put ("на" + Acc., "в" + Acc., etc.)» «Literally садиться means "to seat oneself". It implies movement to a "seat" and, therefore, answers the question "куда?"» — DLI, Lessons 42, 68. From Антон Чехов, «Глупый француз».
exercises.context: The imperfective aspect emphasizes the action itself.

exercises.q: Челаэк! — ___ (обернуться / оборачиваться) он к половому.
exercises.why: The verb написать is called perfective and expresses a single action with emphasis on its completion (either in the past or in the future, since the present tense deals only with actions in progress). — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 37.  ·  From Антон Чехов, «Глупый француз».
exercises.context: The verb написать is called perfective and expresses a single action with emphasis on its completion (either in the past or in the future, since the present tense deals only with actions in progress).

exercises.q: ___ (подать / подавать) сразу штук десять или пятнадцать!
exercises.why: «The imperative may be formed from both the imperfective and the perfective verbs.» — DLI, Lesson 42. From Антон Чехов, «Глупый француз».
exercises.context: «The imperative may be formed from both the imperfective and the perfective verbs.» — DLI, Lesson 42.

exercises.q: Нельзя безнаказанно ___ (съесть / есть) такую массу!
exercises.why: The perfective aspect places the emphasis on the result of the action. — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 37.  ·  From Антон Чехов, «Глупый француз».
exercises.context: The perfective aspect places the emphasis on the result of the action.

exercises.q: И как ___ (низкий), бесчеловечен я, сидя здесь и не идя к нему на помощь!
exercises.why: «There is a limited number of adjectives that normally take the short form when used predicatively … The short form of an adjective can never be used as a modifier.» — DLI, Lesson 57. From Антон Чехов, «Глупый француз».
exercises.context: «There is a limited number of adjectives that normally take the short form when used predicatively … The short form of an adjective can never be used as a modifier.» — DLI, Lesson 57.

exercises.q: Сейчас три ___ (час), а мне к пяти надо быть на юбилейном обеде.
exercises.why: «If the number ends in 2, 3 or 4 use the genitive singular … If the number ends in 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 0 or -надцать use the genitive plural.» «There are also other quantity words that take the genitive, either singular or plural according to meaning: Много, Несколько, Мало, Сколько.» — Wikibooks, «Genitive case». From Антон Чехов, «Глупый француз».
exercises.context: «If the number ends in 2, 3 or 4 use the genitive singular … If the number ends in 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 0 or -надцать use the genitive plural.» «There are also other quantity words that take the genitive, either singular or plural according to meaning: Много,…

exercises.q: Этак и аппетит пропадёт к ___ (чёрт), и опоздаешь…
exercises.why: «The preposition к (to, towards, in the direction of …) always requires the dative case … The preposition по means "along" and is used with the dative case.» — DLI, Lessons 28–29. From Антон Чехов, «Глупый француз».
exercises.context: «The preposition к (to, towards, in the direction of …) always requires the dative case … The preposition по means "along" and is used with the dative case.» — DLI, Lessons 28–29.

exercises.q: Будь этот господин у нас во Франции, его показывали бы за ___ (деньги)…
exercises.why: «Prepositions "В", "НА", "ПОД" and "ЗА" are followed by the Accusative case when they indicate the goal of motion.» — DLI, Lesson 61. From Антон Чехов, «Глупый француз».
exercises.context: «Prepositions "В", "НА", "ПОД" and "ЗА" are followed by the Accusative case when they indicate the goal of motion.» — DLI, Lesson 61.

exercises.q: Нельзя безнаказанно съесть ___ (такая масса)!
exercises.why: «The accusative case is used to denote the direct object of the preceding verb and answers the questions кого? — whom? or что? — what?» — DLI, Lesson 18. From Антон Чехов, «Глупый француз».
exercises.context: «The accusative case is used to denote the direct object of the preceding verb and answers the questions кого? — whom? or что? — what?» — DLI, Lesson 18.

exercises.q: Я вас не понимаю! — замотал головой сосед, тараща на ___ (француз) глаза.
exercises.why: «Prepositions "В", "НА", "ПОД" and "ЗА" are followed by the Accusative case when they indicate the goal of motion.» — DLI, Lesson 61. From Антон Чехов, «Глупый француз».
exercises.context: «Prepositions "В", "НА", "ПОД" and "ЗА" are followed by the Accusative case when they indicate the goal of motion.» — DLI, Lesson 61.

exercises.context: «The main functions of the nominative case are: a. The nominative of the subject: Студент читает.» — DLI, Lesson 16.

exercises.q: ___ (подать) бутылку Нюи… — сказал сосед, принимая от полового икру и лук.
exercises.why: «The perfective future consists of one word only and resembles in form the present tense. It is formed from the perfective infinitive: напишу, сделаю, получу, выучу.» — DLI, Lesson 37. From Антон Чехов, «Глупый француз».
